stem: What was one major effect of the Second Great Awakening?

options.label: A
options.text: Churches turned away from public politics and focused on internal religious issues.

options.label: B
options.text: People were inspired to join reform movements to address social problems.

options.label: C
options.text: Religious leaders petitioned legislatures to extend suffrage to women.

options.label: D
options.text: Politicians were encouraged to promote states' rights rather than federal unity.
